data_description.ssh_key_path: Absolute path to the SSH private key on the HA host. Example: /config/ssh/id_ed25519
data_description.ap_hosts: Comma-separated IPs of OpenWrt access points to collect Wi-Fi associations and host stats from. Port 22 is used by default; add :2222 for IPv4 or [2001:db8::22]:2222 for IPv6. Example: 192.168.1.22,192.168.1.23:2222
data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the gateway and APs. Minimum 30 s, maximum 3600 s. Default: 60 s.
data_description.lan_iface: Bridge interface used for the LAN on OpenWrt. Default: br-lan. Change only if your router uses a different name.
data_description.wan_iface: WAN-facing interface on the gateway used to read RX/TX byte counters. Default: eth0.
data_description.disconnect_threshold_s: How long a device must be absent before a disconnect event is recorded. Default: 120 s (2 missed scans at 60 s interval).
data_description.presence_macs: Comma-separated MAC addresses to track as presence binary sensors. Each MAC becomes a binary_sensor.wrtsensor_presence_* entity. Example: aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff,11:22:33:44:55:66
data_description.enable_dns_stats: Signal dnsmasq each scan to collect cache hit-rate, latency, and per-upstream history for the DNS stats card. Disable to skip the SIGUSR1 + logread on every scan and the DNS history file I/O. Requires a configured gateway. Default: on.
data_description.enable_host_metrics: Collect CPU, RAM, and root storage usage for every configured OpenWrt host, then expose per-host sensors. Disable to skip those commands and remove the CPU/RAM/Disk entities on reload. Default: on.
data_description.enable_wireguard: Auto-detect WireGuard on the gateway and APs each scan, then expose per-peer device_trackers and a card with handshake age, transfer totals, and live rate. Hosts without `wg` installed are skipped silently. Private and preshared keys are never read into HA — only public keys, descriptions, endpoints, and counters. Default: off.
data_description.wg_stale_threshold_s: Peers whose last handshake is older than this go to not_home and grey out in the card. WireGuard handshakes every ~2 minutes when active. Default: 180.
data_description.enable_asu: Add an Update entity per OpenWrt host that polls the OpenWrt Attended Sysupgrade service every few hours via the device's `owut` tool (24.10+; install with `opkg update && opkg install owut`). Each entity exposes a LuCI link to that host's Attended Sysupgrade page — click it to perform the actual upgrade. Default: off.
data_description.asu_interval_s: How often each host probes sysupgrade.openwrt.org. Min 1 h, max 24 h. Default: 21600 (6 h).
